subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation adopt the full shared configured-provider-request contract, including both existing private-network opt-ins, through `useConfiguredRequest`?
rationale: The implementation is consistent with the established provider contract, but it intentionally changes which private destinations and configured request policies the xAI image route may use; that security and compatibility boundary requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the shared contract
options.body: Keep `useConfiguredRequest`, require production-path proof for default deny and both opt-ins, and merge after provider/security review.

options.title: Narrow the behavior
options.body: Limit the change to one explicitly approved private-network policy if maintainers do not want all configured request fields to apply to xAI images.

options.title: Retain hard denial
options.body: Close the PR and document that private xAI image endpoints are intentionally unsupported despite the existing provider-level opt-in.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep `useConfiguredRequest`, require production-path proof for default deny and both opt-ins, and merge after provider/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared provider request and private-network opt-in contract whose intended scope is the central decision here.
